In Tripartite Agreement, formula for calculating of amount of LC/BG is :

options.A: Total freight during the last financial year/Actual days of transaction in concerned month x 2.

items.e: Total freight during the last financial year/Actual days of transaction in concerned month x 2. — that is the right answer. items.q: If railway loco is utilized for sending back the overloaded wagon/wagons to the loading/adjustment point for load adjustment, then _______________charges are levied.
items.e: Option C (Engine Haulage) is the correct choice. If a railway loco is used to send back overloaded wagons to the loading or adjustment point for load adjustment, Engine Haulage charges are levied. The charge recovers the cost of the extra engine working made necessary by overloading detected after weighment. Loading beyond the permissible carrying capacity also attracts penal freight under the weighment rules. Weighbridges at loading points exist to prevent such overloads.

Reconciliation catches mismatches between earnings booked and cash remitted. IPAS, FOIS and TAMS together form the goods accounting chain.
